description: ​Samadhan Techtronics is a leading provider of integrated safety & security solutions. based in Mumbai. With over seven years of expertise, we specialize in safeguarding residential and commercial spaces through cutting-edge technology. From high-definition CCTV surveillance and biometric attendance systems to advanced home automation and fire safety, our mission is to provide "Samadhan" (solutions) that offer peace of mind and operational efficiency. We pride ourselves on professional installation, reliable AMC services, and a customer-first approach.

featured_reviews.name: Sanika Satre
featured_reviews.review_text: ​"I recently had a CCTV system installed by the team. They were punctual, professional, and took the time to explain how the positioning of each camera maximizes our property's coverage. The wiring is incredibly neat, and they cleaned up thoroughly after the job.The image quality on this system is crystal clear, even at night. I’m particularly impressed with the mobile app integration—the motion alerts are instant, and the interface is very user-friendly. It’s given my family a huge sense of security knowing we can check in on the house from anywhere in the world. Highly recommend them if you want a hassle-free setup!"

featured_reviews.name: shashank singh
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently had a security camera system installed by Samadhan, and the experience was top-notch. He was incredibly professional, arriving right on time. The installation is clean with no visible wires. If you want the job done right the first time, I highly recommend them!"
